text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Leave it alone. It was my mistake. I'll 
take care of it myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way to training, I overheard voices 
arguing in front of a massive pile of 
cardboard boxes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing, except that I 
accidentally ordered 1,000 horseshoes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san! We train together, don't we? 
We're more than happy to help you out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We split up immediately to work through 
the massive horseshoe inventory—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The 'Silence Suzuka Memorial Race' is 
currently underway! Participants get free 
horseshoes as a gift!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
What!? We get to race against THE Silence 
Suzuka!? U-Um! I want to join!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
'W-Wowie! These free horseshoes...' Um... 
'They make running super easy, I say unto 
thee~!'

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... Sounds suspicious, but 
hey, if they're free, maybe I'll try them 
out...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, they're affordable! Step 
right up, they're affordable! The very 
horseshoes favored by Brian-san, 
completely free of charge, desu wa!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
They're the same ones Brian-senpai uses!? 
I-I'm not worthy, but... please give me 
some!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bit by bit, the surplus inventory steadily 
dwindled, until—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Remaining... 503 pairs... This is quite 
something...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey... That's enough already. You don't 
need to burden yourselves with this any—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—Isn't this amazing, though!? That means 
500 of them are already gone! That's so, 
so incredible!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! At this rate, the rest will be 
gone in no time! Now, how shall we bargain 
the next batch away, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Why do they always have to be so 
exhausting? Every single one of them.
choice_data_list:
They certainly give you energy, don't 
they?

They certainly give you energy, don't 
they?

Let's come up with the next plan right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...A bit too much energy, if you ask me.

If you don't mind— could I have those 
horseshoes?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose.

If you don't mind— could I have those 
horseshoes?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There are 500 left. Take as many as you 
want.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright... In that case, I'll take all of 
them.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
? Yeah. I'll go through this amount in no 
time. Thanks, you saved me the trouble.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And just like that, the remaining 
horseshoe stock was completely cleared!
